[[Category:Shorts|*]]
[[sn:Shorts]]Shorts are short YouTube videos in a vertical format. They can also be posted on [[Tiktok]] or [[Instagram]]. [[Immanuelle]] posts them [[Immanuelle's YouTube Channel|their youtube channel]] and Tiktok only.

[[Template:Short]] is the template used for their documentation

== Posted locations ==
https://www.tiktok.com/@their_holiness

https://www.youtube.com/c/Immanuelle/shorts

==Strategic differences==

Shorts can be up to 60 seconds long on YouTube. On Tiktok they can be up to 3 minutes but all shorts will be made with the intention of being posted on YouTube too

Unlike long form videos they do not have a built in recommendation linking feature. That makes them a bit more difficult to use for session time, they rely on algorithmic recommendations.

== Ways of making shorts ==

===Tiktok UI===
Tiktok has a UI that allows for easy video creation. It also allows for easy addition of music which tends to get a video taken down on YouTube.

The majority of Immanuelle's current shorts were created with this program

== Tiktok options ==

=== Landscape videos ===
Tiktok has the ability to make videos landscape.<ref>https://www.tiktok.com/@otakufoxx/video/7028256536292035846?is_from_webapp=v1&item_id=7028256536292035846</ref> This turns out to be because any aspect ratio can be uploaded to tiktok and it is not an option in settings
===Duets===
Tiktok duets may be an effective means for growth. I have done zero research on them and never made a duet before

My initial attempts at duet creation suggest it is unfeasible as I need to use my camera rather than putting clever things in. Might be able to do a vtuber duet or something but it seems unlikely. Duets do not look like an effective means for promotion at the time

==YouTube options==
Youtube allows some kind of long form video integration I believe, however I have not figured out how to use it
I'm convinced this does not actually exist
